tool_input.summary:
Fixed the two remaining hover/selection performance bottlenecks in the sketchpad:

1. **useDesignAppIsPieceHovered** — Was subscribing to the full hover object via `createDesignHoverSelector` (returns entire `DesignAppHover`), causing ALL piece components to re-render on any hover change.
